line: Give an old friend an unexpected phone call.
paragraph: Chef Maddy Goldberg makes cooking videos online using recipes from scratch. Every Tuesday in the Toronto area, she uses her time to cook something different. She takes random ingredients found at a local food bank to prepare large meals. These banquets serve 100 people in need. The food tastes a little sweeter because of her work. We are grateful for her steady hands in the kitchen.

seed.summary: Cooking content can be extremely popular on social media, but watching Toronto-area Chef Maddy Goldberg narrate her made-from-scratch recipes, it suddenly all tastes a little sweeter.
